title: Studio: a Chinese name yields no identifier at any create door; derive one by pinyin, by one rule everywhere
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ② filed on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「同意立卡」, agreeing the four UX proposals with the direction written here. Priority on 「相关卡 p1, 让车道处理」. ⛔ Not a claim.
Reader: `domain:ui`. If the pinyin source belongs on the server, say so in the claim.
Dedupe: `pinyin api name`, `API name Chinese label`, `not derived`. `@objectstack/plugin-pinyin-search` is search recall only. **New.**
type: enhancement

**Business reason.** A Chinese-speaking administrator names things in Chinese. Today every create door stops them and asks them to invent an English identifier, several times in their first ten minutes.

## What happens

Read on `main` at `3482f3d8d2`. Type 维修中心 or 客户等级 as the name: the identifier stays empty, and Create waits for a hand-typed one.

| door | where | sentence (zh) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| New package | `metadata-admin/PackageFormDialog.tsx:538` | 显示名称里没有可用来生成 ID 的英文字母，请手动填写 |
| New object and other items | `studio-design/CreateItemDialog.tsx:113` (`toFieldNameLoose`) | 显示名称里没有可用来生成标识的英文字母 |
| Add field | `studio-design/AddFieldPopover.tsx:147` | 标签里没有可用来生成 API 名称的英文字母 |
| Generic create | `metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx:739` | `engine.create.nameNotDerived` |

An independent review also reports the picklist option value door, and that the package dialog's subtitle promises its advanced section is filled in from the name. Check both.

## Direction (agreed)

- One derivation, shared by every door: Latin letters as today; Chinese by pinyin, as snake_case (`weixiu_zhongxin`). The preview shows it, and the person can still edit it.
- ⛔ Not a generated opaque name such as `field_3`. These identifiers are written into formulas and APIs, so a person and an AI must be able to read them.
- The existing rules hold: the namespace prefix, the `__c` suffix in a pair, and the taken-name hint. A collision gets the existing hint.
- `pinyin-pro` is a dependency of the server plugin only today. Weigh the console bundle cost against an alternative, and state the choice in the PR.

## Done when

Each door above, in zh-CN, offers a valid editable identifier for a Chinese name, and a pin covers the shared derivation.

Links back: #29672 (the run that met this).
